method: Weekly PubMed search for recent peer-reviewed autism research aligned with JourHelp's support, accommodation, sensory, masking, burnout, communication, diagnosis, and quality-of-life goals.

studies.title: Optimizing Inpatient Care for Children With Autism Spectrum Disorder: A Multidisciplinary and Sensory-Informed Approach.
studies.authors: Drewry M, Gross E, Jakubowski E et al.
studies.preview: Pediatric hospitalists continue to optimize inpatient care for children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD), their families, and caregivers. The unfamiliar and overstimulating hospital environment frequently heightens distress, contributing to challenging behaviors and resistance to medical care.

studies.title: Longitudinal changes in parent-reported sensory processing from childhood to adolescence in autistic individuals: a long-term follow-up study from Türkiye.
studies.authors: Kaya Evsen S, Kars Kızılkoca S, Huri M
studies.preview: Sensory processing differences are common among autistic individuals and may change across development. However, longitudinal evidence describing how these patterns evolve during the transition from childhood to adolescence remains limited.

studies.title: Sensory Overstimulation: A Virtual Reality Simulation to Foster Empathy Towards Autistic Youth.
studies.journal: Studies in health technology and informatics
studies.authors: Andersen AD, Møller ME, Frandsen MS et al.
studies.preview: This paper investigates whether a Virtual Reality (VR) simulation of sensory overstimulation in a classroom can increase empathy and understanding toward individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) among students aged 13-15 in Danish elementary schools. The project followed an iterative design process in which a...

studies.title: Outcomes of sensory integration therapy in children with autism spectrum disorder: a non-randomized pre-post intervention study.
studies.authors: Rahman RMA, Sayed MM, Samei AMA et al.
studies.preview: Sensory processing abnormalities have been linked to autism symptoms. Sensory integration therapy (SIT) affects autism symptom severity, sensory profile and related socio-demographic/clinical variables.

studies.title: The active self in autism: multisensory and sensorimotor foundations of bodily self-representation.
studies.preview: The active self, understood as the embodied sense of self arising from goal-directed action and interaction with the environment, is supported by sensorimotor processes including multisensory integration and proprioception. Atypical self-representation in autism spectrum disorder (ASD) has been proposed to relate to...

studies.title: From Signal to Memory: A Proposed Adaptive Hierarchy Linking Autism-Associated Genes to Sensory Homeostasis.
studies.preview: Every nervous system must preserve sensitivity to change while reducing responses to constancy. This review defines that adaptive objective as sensory homeostasis : the process through which familiar information recedes while unexpected or biologically important events remain salient.

studies.title: Sex-Related Specificities of Sensory Profiles in Autism Spectrum Disorder: Impact on Clinical Functioning.
studies.authors: Pezone M, Garotti R, Sgueglia E et al.
studies.preview: Background and Objectives: Sensory anomalies are a distinctive feature of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) individuals and appear to differ in intensity, frequency, and subtype between male and female subjects. According to the diagnostic framework of the DSM-5-TR, these sensory patterns are key clinical indicators.

studies.title: Aging in Autism: An Event-Related Potentials Study of Auditory Change Detection.
studies.authors: Bessé M, Morel-Kohlmeyer S, Houy-Durand E et al.
studies.preview: Autistic individuals are often thought to exhibit reduced tolerance for change, which may stem from atypicalities in sensory processing, particularly in the detection of environmental changes.
